lines.zh: 我下半身是蛇，走起来很长。
lines.en: My lower half is serpent. Long strides.
Scales rasp the ground.

lines.zh: 我上半身是人，走路时微微前倾。
lines.en: Human above. I lean forward slightly.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过地砖，留下湿痕。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the tiles, leaving a wet trail.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地滑过去，不着急。
lines.en: I slide over, unhurried.

lines.zh: 这条路上有我的味道了。
lines.en: This path smells of me now.
My skirt sweeps the stones.

lines.zh: 我一边滑行一边侧头看。
lines.en: Gliding and tilting my head.
I keep to the walls, in shadow.
I slip around a pillar. Smooth.
Coming your way. Slowly.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后卷起来。
lines.en: My tail curls behind me.
I coil up like a pile of rope.
I smooth my hair with one hand.
Too cold here. My scales tighten.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处是竖的。
lines.en: In the dark, my eyes are slits.
Water in the stone. I hear it.
No sleep needed. Just coiling.
My tail tip taps the floor.

lines.zh: 蛇尾盘着，我等你先迈步。
lines.en: Tail coiled, I wait for your first step.

lines.zh: 这身躯干很沉，站起来费劲。
lines.en: Heavy body. Standing takes effort.

lines.zh: 我慢慢吐了口气，没有声。
lines.en: I exhale slowly. No sound.
Shorter than me. I look down.

lines.zh: 我的头歪着，蛇的那部分在动。
lines.en: Head tilted. The serpent part stirs.
Skin like that would open at one stroke.

lines.zh: 你想看我的尾巴？它不欢迎。
lines.en: Want to see my tail? It's unwelcoming.

lines.zh: 我抬眼的时候，你已经退了。
lines.en: When I look up, you've stepped back.

lines.zh: 我的笑容，你觉得不好看吧。
lines.en: My smile. You find it unpleasant.
Your hands shake. I see.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一段距离，我不喜欢。
lines.en: This distance between us. I dislike it.
You've been staring at my lower half.

lines.zh: 我抬头，比你高出一个头。
lines.en: Head up. I'm a head taller.
Your blade slid off my scales.

lines.zh: 我退了半圈，尾巴收起来。
lines.en: I coil back half a turn.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住了你的手感。
lines.en: I know how you hit now.
A scale came off. Ugly.
I won't cry out. That would look weak.
I brace on the pillar.

lines.zh: 二十八点护甲，也被你敲响。
lines.en: Twenty-eight armor, and you still rang it.

lines.zh: 伤口在腰上，鳞片替它挡了。
lines.en: The wound is at my waist; scales took the rest.
One split scale — worth it.

lines.zh: 我笑起来的时候，你要小心。
lines.en: Beware when I smile.

lines.zh: 放下的肉太静，你还会动。
lines.en: The meat lies still; you still move.
Holding it up. Your hand is too close.
Not enough to wrap once.
The smell of raw blood draws me most.
Put it down. Go to the wall.
I'm not eating that piece.

lines.zh: 我看着你的手腕，不是那东西。
lines.en: I'm looking at your wrist, not the item.
This much won't buy anything.
Steady hand. A pity.

lines.zh: 我把头偏了一下，你可以走了。
lines.en: I tilt my head away. You may go.
You hit my tail.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，鳞片立起来。
lines.en: Half a step back. Scales rise.

lines.zh: 我的身体很沉，撞不动的。
lines.en: Heavy body. Can't be shoved.
Your hand touched my waist.
Don't press close. I coil.

lines.zh: 这一下，你退到了石柱边。
lines.en: Now you're against the pillar.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我的尾巴动了一下。
lines.en: The bump moved my tail.

lines.zh: 裙下是尾巴，踩了会缠人。
lines.en: Under this skirt is a tail that coils when stepped on.

lines.zh: 我们离得这么近，很危险。
lines.en: This close is dangerous.

lines.zh: 我让开一点，尾巴还在你脚边。
lines.en: I shift aside. My tail stays at your feet.
Few are like me.
Stand there. Let me look.
My lower half frightens you.

lines.zh: 我不需要躲，我盘着就好。
lines.en: No need to hide. Coiling is enough.

lines.zh: 靠得太近，我的鳞会刮到你。
lines.en: Any closer and my scales would scrape you.

lines.zh: 退后一点，这个距离合适。
lines.en: A bit further. That's the right distance.
I never begin such things.
Lower your head.
That's exactly right.
Any more and I coil.
As I bend, my tail stays raised.

lines.zh: 尾巴卷起来，把它递给我。
lines.en: My tail curls and hands it up.
This is cold. I dislike it.
Up to my eye. My scales catch the light.

lines.zh: 地上还有别的，我用尾巴卷。
lines.en: More here. My tail sweeps it.
I bend to take it. Tail keeps moving.
My sleeve is cold, just as I like it.
My tail doesn't even feel the weight.
It warmed in my palm.
I look at it. Long stillness.
You moved. So I chose.
My eyes lift. Slit pupils on you.

lines.zh: 这段距离，我滑过去很快。
lines.en: This distance. I close it quickly.

lines.zh: 你的脚踝，最好不要离开地面。
lines.en: Your ankle had better not leave the ground.
I'm at your flank already.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的门，我刚关上。
lines.en: I just closed the only door in this room.
Waiting for you to beg.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道变得很重。
lines.en: Your scent got stronger.
I lower my head, a little closer.
You've backed onto the pillar. Perfect.
Locked on. Not changing.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴已经在你脚边。
lines.en: My tail is at your feet.
No need to look back. I'm ahead.
Coiled and ready. Starting.
Don't run; my tail is faster than legs.
This will be easier.
When you panic, my tongue tastes it.
Now. Eyes on me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢滑过去，尾巴先到。
lines.en: I slide in. Tail first.
You retreat. My tail follows.
Your legs will tire first.
No need for hands. The tail suffices.
Your weapon won't cut scales.
You have backed onto the third tile.

lines.zh: 石柱中间有空隙，我能过去。
lines.en: There's a gap between the pillars. I fit.
My tail drags along the ground.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面，你看不清楚。
lines.en: Low to the floor. You can't see clearly.
This is my nest.
Coiled in the dark until you doze.
Your back is sweating.
Just this last bit.
My head is at your shoulder.
Don't move. Stay right there.

lines.zh: 我盘在石柱下，等你经过。
lines.en: Coiled beneath the pillar. Waiting for you to pass.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在地上轻轻地扫。
lines.en: My tail brushes the floor.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在石板上回响。
lines.en: Your steps echo on the stone.

lines.zh: 你喜欢看我的上半身，那就多看。
lines.en: You like the upper half. Keep looking.

lines.zh: 你退的时候，我的尾巴绕过去了。
lines.en: As you retreat, my tail goes around.
One loop of the tail. Caught.
You're lifted a little.
My nails aren't long. Hard, though.
That one pressed your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴收紧，你听见骨响。
lines.en: The tail tightens. You hear the rib.
You kicked me. My scales hurt your foot.
Half a coil back, then around again.
Your weapon hit the floor.
No blood from that. A mark instead.
I speak at your ear.
Wrapped up, you can't even stand.

lines.zh: 我的力气不算大，但够用。
lines.en: Not much strength. Enough.
You're still struggling. Interesting.
That put you on the floor.
You're down. My tail stays.
Struggle once more. Try.
I dislike wasting strength.

lines.zh: 我的指甲刮过你的锁骨。
lines.en: My nails rake across your collarbone.
See. So quiet now.
I loosen a little. Breathe.
I slide out from behind the pillar.
A long track on the floor now.
I appear coiled, then unfold.
The pillars here suit me.
I raise my head. My hair falls.
Scales shine in the dark.
I've chosen this ground for a nest.

lines.zh: 你进来的时候，我已经在了。
lines.en: I was here before you came in.
Uncoiling to my full height, taller than you.
My scent spreads out first.
Only one path on this floor.

lines.zh: 我从地上起来，裙子拖过灰。
lines.en: I rise. My skirt drags the dust.
Fire on scales. The smell is awful.

lines.zh: 摔下去，尾巴砸在地上很重。
lines.en: Falling. My tail hit hard.
Water on my scales. Irritating.
The blast lifted my skirt.
Something lodged between scales.
That light softened my scales.
Long since I ate anything living.

lines.zh: 雷打在鳞上，整条尾巴都麻。
lines.en: Lightning on my scales. My whole tail numb.

lines.zh: 往下掉，尾巴还在找东西缠。
lines.en: Falling. My tail still seeks something to coil.
